scope: Offline implementation, six tests, preserved result, prior native compact mechanism probe and report interpretation. P2/P3 already have separate accepted conditional proof reviews. No estimator, proof, source, result or report edited by reviewer.

blocking_findings.finding: The optional upper argument is not checked for exact finite rational type. certificate(3, upper=(float("nan"), float("nan"))) returns exact_rational_comparisons_passed=true and proved_rational_upper={A:"nan",B:"nan"}, because both greater-than comparisons against NaN are false. Positive infinity and ordinary float pairs are also accepted and labeled rational. Thus the certificate API can report success without finite rational upper constants.
blocking_findings.impact: Fail-closed behavior is incomplete at the explicitly exposed alternate-certificate input. This does not invalidate either default Fraction certificate or the preserved result, whose comparisons are exact and reproduce byte-for-byte.
blocking_findings.required_change: Validate upper as exactly two nonnegative Fraction constants before comparison (or an explicitly documented exact-rational conversion that rejects nonfinite/inexact inputs); add targeted rejection tests for NaN, infinity, ordinary floats and malformed constant sequences. Preserve the original evidence and bind any repaired implementation to a distinct result.
blocking_findings.required_re_review: Fresh independent implementation/result review after repair.

verified_findings.finding: For n=3,4 the hard-coded polynomials and recurrences agree. All root brackets have positive ordered disjoint endpoints and exact opposite signs; n sign changes exhaust degree n. Horner interval multiplication, rational series remainder with successive ratios bounded by x/50, reciprocal reversal, endpoint monotonicity, and interval differences conservatively enclose the extrema and total variation. The default A/B acceptance comparisons use Fraction throughout; float conversion occurs only in displayed diagnostics after acceptance. Rounded float display fields must not be reused as outward-certified intervals.

Too-small rational constants, missing roots, reversed/overlapping repeated roots, non-sign-changing intervals and exponential x=50 are rejected. These checks remain useful but do not cover the malformed upper-input defect.

The new Python implementation uses analytic log-tau derivative product-rule recurrences through order four, with copied pre-interval states, signed current and actual zero/irregular intervals. It does not invoke the prior native field or fit routines. Its suffix-expression test independently checks chronological convolution assembly at every prefix; the polynomial recurrence itself is shared and is separately algebraically tested. Public sample bytes reconstructed during review match the prior observations_sha256.

All seven offset records have three branch value maxima and three branch derivative maxima, giving 42 compared scalar quantities. The maximum discrepancy is 1.9984014443252818e-15 mV. The prior compact JSON and generator are source-bound, and the generator uses separately verified native binaries. No ignored raw trajectory or native rebuild is needed for this review. Matching finite maxima is a mechanism check, not independent physical validation or a uniform bound.

All six tests pass: exact polynomial identities, rational certificate/rejection cases, chronological derivatives and constant-current identities, public Taylor bounds, dense joint precision/forecast and likelihood identities, and the Gaussian accumulation example. The dense NumPy tests use 30 common-anchor cases and retain cross terms. Reported values, 0.15933665092220123 illustrative radius, 106 uV and 1.802 mV summed bounds, 334 uV sampled largest branch error and -5518.8 ten-year log odds agree with the result.

Report correctly distinguishes exact stationary mathematical envelopes from floating finite diagnostics and illustrative tolerance inputs. Same-anchor Gauss-Newton precision bounds are not coverage or fit-to-fit guarantees; RC-only analysis leaves H2, uncertain inputs, aging, thermal paths, numerical accumulation and whole-likelihood fidelity open. Storage numbers are unchanged partial candidate totals; this offline code adds no runtime storage or runtime admission gate.

Every one of the seven preserved result bindings matches current bytes/SHA256, P2/P3 proof review bindings match the reviewed files, and the fresh run is byte-identical without excluding any fields. The report final-receipt reference is prospective; final acceptance must await repair and re-review.
